jobs.title: Manager, Industry & Product Operations
jobs.description:
**Manager, Industry & Product Operations**

**Location:** Remote (U.S.) | Travel as needed

**Reports to:** VP, Product & Industry Operations

***Build the commercial lens behind every product line***

ECI serves more than 25,000 customers across five industries. Our business is complex by design — built through more than 60 acquisitions and spanning verticals from manufacturing to field service, retail, and beyond. That complexity creates a real gap: no one has consistently owned the cross-product view of how our software is actually living inside our customers.

Sales Ops watches the health of the sales engine. Marketing Ops watches the demand engine. CS Ops & Retention runs the retention engine.

Industry & Product Ops watches each product line and vertical as a business — covering the full arc from pipeline to churn, with the heaviest weight on one question: how is the product actually living inside our customers?

**This role runs and strengthens that function day-to-day.**

**What you'll do**

* **Own and maintain the product health scorecard.** Maintain a single scorecard by product line — pipeline, win rate, ASP, attach and cross-sell, GRR/NRR, and churn — with one definition set reviewed monthly by Product and GTM leadership.

* **Translate data into clear, actionable recommendations.** Convert product usage, CRM, billing, and support data into crisp summaries of where products are winning, leaking, or stalling — packaged for leadership to act on, not just review.

* **Prepare and coordinate the monthly product business review.** Own the prep work, scorecard assembly, and agenda — so the cross-functional conversation between Product and GTM leaders is focused, well-supported, and runs on time.

* **Analyze and escalate product-attributable churn.** Root-cause losses and churn at the product level, quantify the ARR impact, and surface the top findings with clear remediation options for leadership to prioritize into the product roadmap.

* **Maintain and influence the cross-sell whitespace and attach strategy.** Maintain and adjust the cross-sell whitespace model by vertical — in partnership with Sales Ops and CS Ops — to keep pipeline fed with real expansion opportunity.

* **Monitor the full product lifecycle and flag risk.** Track where each product wins, stalls, and loses customers from onboarding through renewal, and surface emerging patterns — with supporting data — for leadership to act on across the portfolio.

* **Implement and refine automated signal detection.** Do the hands-on build and maintenance work to automate health scorecarding, adoption tracking, and signal detection using agents — so the scorecard stays agent-maintained, not analyst-maintained.

* **Feed product intelligence into the broader GTM motion.** Ensure timely, accurate product- and vertical-level data reaches Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Product Management to support pipeline health, pricing decisions, and deal structure.

**Who you are**

* **5–8 years in product strategy and operations, business ops, or GTM strategy in multi-product B2B SaaS.** Experience in SMB, vertical software, or an acquisition-built portfolio is a strong plus.

* 5–8 years in product strategy and operations, business ops, or GTM strategy in multi-product B2B SaaS. Experience in SMB, vertical software, or an acquisition-built portfolio is a strong plus.

* Genuinely fluent in product and revenue analytics. You can go from raw data to a clear recommendation without waiting on a BI queue. Funnels, cohorts, retention curves, adoption metrics, and ARR math are familiar tools — you use them, not just request reports built on them.

* Effective presenting to and collaborating with Product and GTM leaders. You organize evidence clearly, translate data into crisp recommendations, and hold your own in cross-functional conversations without needing to own the room.

* AI-native by instinct. Your default is to automate the analysis, not run it manually every month. You know how to build and contribute to agent-maintained workflows, and you apply that standard to your own work first.

* A self-directed, consistent operator. You understand what good looks like, you execute reliably, and you help the people around you do the same. You thrive with clear direction and minimal hand-holding, and you raise problems early rather than waiting for someone else to notice them.

**Not required:** *An MBA, a consulting pedigree, or a "Product Ops" title. We care what you've built.*

**Why this role matters**

ECI's commercial decisions — roadmap investments, pricing, M&A integration, and retention strategy — have historically been made without a consistent, product-level read on commercial health. This role changes that.

You'll run the day-to-day operations of this function, keep the scorecard sharp and consistent, and serve as the intelligence layer connecting GTM and Product at the team level. The work you do will directly shape what ECI acts on, quarter over quarter.

**This is high-impact execution, not a support function.**

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager - Deal Desk
jobs.description:
**About Tekion:**
-----------------

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

**Job Introduction:**
---------------------

Tekion's automotive retail platform, including payments and AI products, serves dealerships and dealer groups. Note: "Sales Operations Manager" is an individual-contributor title at Tekion; this role has no direct reports. On Deal Desk you apply and enforce product structure, pricing and discount policy on live deals, acting as the control point between Sales, Finance and Legal: deals are structured correctly, approved quickly and booked cleanly. You say yes fast on standard deals, find a workable structure on complex ones, and protect compliance.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
---------------------------------

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Development/Product, and Implementation to address deal-related questions and challenges, develop solutions, and ensure alignment on deal structure.
* Review quotes, order forms and contracts for pricing, terms, SKU accuracy and policy fit; coach reps on structure requirements.
* Facilitate guidance on concise deal summaries covering economics, exceptions, risks, and recommendations for leadership review and approvals with clear rationale and an audit trail.
* Guide complex nonstandard commercial and enterprise transactions including multi-year commitments, phased deployments, ramp pricing, payment, product bundles, and negotiated commercial terms and route to Leadership, Finance, Legal or Product.
* Manage quote-to-cash coordination on all quote types with respective cross functional team members to ensure approved and signed terms translate accurately into bookings, billing, order fulfillment, and renewal records, reporting any process concerns to leaders timely.
* Maintain accuracy while managing multiple deals with monthly and quarterly deadlines
* Verify bookings meet company policy and partner with Finance on revenue-recognition compliance.
* Own the handoff to Finance, billing and order management; resolve discrepancies quickly.
* Improve quote-to-cash workflows, quoting rules and approval flows with Business Systems.
* Report on cycle time, approval volume and booking quality; document playbooks and train Sales.
* Support related work as needed, such as forecasting, cancellations, quota and compensation inputs, or ad hoc analysis.

**Basic** **Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* 6-8 years in sales operations, deal desk, revenue operations or business operations, with direct exposure to deal review, quoting or contracts.

* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, approval workflows and configuration concepts.

* Track record of improving deal quality through data, process and clear communication.

* Experience influencing stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, and Product.

* Strong analytical skills (Excel or Sheets, BI reporting) with understanding of accounting and enforced commercial judgment.

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Finance or a related field, or equivalent in experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CPQ tools (e.g., Salesforce CPQ, NUE CPQ).

* SaaS or technology experience.

* Revenue recognition basics and order-to-cash process.

* Automotive retail or dealer software, or payments, familiarity.

* MBA or advanced degree.

**Perks & Benefits**
--------------------

* Competitive compensation and generous stock options
* 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage
* Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages
* The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies
* Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper
* Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up
* A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration
* The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy
* Exciting opportunities for career growth and development

jobs.title: Sr Compliance Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Wealth Enhancement**

Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We continually seek to perfect our craft of personalized financial planning with our team-based Roundtable and UniFi processes that go far beyond the standard approach. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices - and growing - nationwide.

Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit www.wealthenhancement.com.

We have an exciting opportunity for a **Compliance Operations Sr. Manager**! The Compliance Operations Sr. Manager is responsible for supporting the effective execution and continuous improvement of the firm’s Compliance program. The role helps establish the structure, ownership, processes, and reporting necessary to manage compliance projects and recurring obligations effectively. A key focus of the position is strengthening Compliance through effective project management and the use of governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) technology to improve workflow, accountability, documentation, and visibility. The role also supports the firm’s policy and procedure governance process and helps translate compliance requirements into practical, sustainable operating processes. The Compliance Operations Sr. Manager supervises assigned personnel and coordinates work across Compliance and other business functions. Success requires exceptional organization and follow-through, strong project-management skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

This is a **Remote** position.

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is **$130,000.00 to $150,000.00**, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.

**Primary Job Functions**

**Compliance Operations & Execution**

* Lead and coordinate Compliance Operations programs, projects, and recurring obligations, establishing clear ownership, deliverables, deadlines, and escalation points.
* Manage assigned personnel, including establishing priorities and expectations, allocating work, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting employee development.
* Develop and maintain project plans and tracking mechanisms for complex compliance initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines, and drive assigned initiatives through implementation and completion.
* Maintain visibility into active projects, recurring requirements, outstanding commitments, risks, and required follow-up, and provide clear status reporting to management.
* Identify delays, resource constraints, control gaps, and emerging risks and coordinate appropriate follow-up or escalation.
* Develop practical reporting and metrics to support prioritization, capacity management, and oversight of Compliance Operations activities.

**GRC, Workflow & Process Improvement**

* Support the continued development and adoption of the firm's regulatory compliance GRC and workflow capabilities.
* Translate compliance requirements and operational processes into structured workflows with defined ownership, deadlines, approvals, documentation requirements, and escalation paths.

**Summary**  
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented patent firm operations manager to join our growing team. Reporting to our managing partner and working closely with our office administrator and AI Value Committee, you will play a crucial role in shaping the AI-powered tools and processes used by our administrative staff and practitioners. While automation is the initial focus, this is a broader operations role, and less of a technical one, working with practitioners and staff across the firm.

Duties Include:

* Mapping and measuring current administrative workflows to identify automation opportunities and track results.
* Evaluating the ever-changing vendor products and custom tools in the marketplace in comparison to SB’s present approaches including discussions with software/AI vendors.

* Designing review checkpoints and quality controls so automated work meets SB’s accuracy standards, particularly for deadlines and filings.

* You have an enthusiasm for **both patent law and AI/software automation, and curiosity about AI capabilities and limitations.**

* You are proactive, adaptable, enjoy tackling new challenges, and thrive in a collaborative environment.

Qualification (Preferred):

What We Offer:

* Comprehensive benefits package including 401(k) with company match, health insurance, etc.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bonneville Labs is a flexible coworking and traditional lab space operator and developer optimized for a community of Bio-Doers, emerging biotechnology companies, community partners, and life sciences market leaders. Bonneville Labs believes that research and development organizations can innovate faster when their mind-share is freed up from operations to focus on discovery and product development. Bonneville Labs seeks to improve our world and lives by eliminating operational hurdles and reducing the cost of research and development for our member companies and allowing them to go forward, faster toward world changing discoveries and businesses.

**Program Manager, Operations and Strategy**
============================================

Reports To: CEO

**Job Overview**
----------------

Bonneville Labs advances transformative bio‑economy solutions by removing operational friction for emerging biotechnology companies. Our coworking and traditional lab spaces support a community of Bio‑Doers who innovate faster when freed from operational burdens.

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. This role builds structured systems, harmonizes workflows, and ensures programs move from planning to completion with clarity, accountability, and measurable outcomes. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

This role is essential for aligning timelines, goals, documentation, and operational systems across the Bonneville Labs ecosystem. The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

**Responsibilities and Duties**
-------------------------------

### **Program Leadership and Oversight**

* Lead assigned programs from ideation through planning, launch, and completion.
* Balance strategic planning with hands‑on execution to keep programs moving without gaps or delays.
* Ensure each project phase has clear ownership, verified completion, and documented quality checks.
* Conduct post‑implementation reviews and initiate timely improvements when needed.
* Oversee program dashboards, timelines, and tracking systems using Smartsheets, UpKeep, and related platforms.
* Identify execution gaps and intervene to ensure corrective actions are taken.
* Provide coaching, oversight, and accountability management for the Project Supervisor.
* Translate operational needs into structured backlogs, sprints, and release cycles.
* Maintain consistent standards, workflows, and performance expectations across all sites.

### **Cross‑Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Lab Operations, Lab Safety and Compliance, Facilities, Member Services, Community, Scientific Services, and Business Operations.
* Facilitate communication and reporting to ensure clarity of expectations, deliverables, and timelines.
* Lead cross‑functional project meetings, document decisions, and track action items.
* Support multi‑site initiatives and harmonization of processes across all Bonneville Labs locations.
* Serve as a central point of contact for program updates, escalations, and issue resolution.
* Partner with leadership to ensure programs support member experience, operational uptime, and regulatory compliance.
* Support KPI tracking across programs including uptime, NPS, SLA adherence, and operational efficiency.

### **Documentation and Quality Management**

* Develop, update, and implement SOPs, protocols, and operational documentation.
* Maintain document control procedures including version control, access permissions, and archival.
* Ensure documentation meets regulatory, safety, and quality standards in coordination with the Senior Manager of EHS.
* Convert tribal knowledge into structured, repeatable documentation that supports future site expansion.
* Support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System.
* Assist in development and implementation of Environmental Health and Safety Management Plans and operational guidelines.

### **Continuous Improvement and Product Mindset**

* Identify inefficiencies and propose improvements to workflows, systems, and processes.
* Implement tools and methodologies that enhance tracking, documentation, and reporting.
* Lead harmonization and continuous improvement projects across teams and sites.
* Support development of operational frameworks, testing services, and scalable systems for future sites.
* Recommend improvements that support member experience and operational excellence.
* Support automation initiatives such as ticket routing, asset tracking, and predictive maintenance pilots.
* Contribute to monthly or quarterly operational release notes.
* Coordinate predictable release cycles and communicate improvements across teams and to members.

### **Operations and Site Support**

* Support day‑to‑day operations across multiple Bonneville Labs sites.
* Assist with project planning and ownership of assigned operational systems.
* Provide onsite or virtual support for Bay Area sites as determined by leadership.
* Prepare detailed presentations summarizing program status, risks, and outcomes.
* Support emergency response coordination and communication with external stakeholders when needed.
* Ensure suppliers, contractors, and member companies comply with Bonneville Labs policies and safety guidelines.
* Support operational readiness for new site launches through documentation, playbooks, and process standardization.
* Monitor vendor and contractor performance to ensure service levels support operational uptime and member experience.

### **Stakeholder and Member Support**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, and member companies.

PRIMARY FUNCTION
  
  
The Program Manager, People Strategy & Transformation, leads the planning, development, and execution of strategic HR initiatives that advance organizational effectiveness, workforce capabilities, and business transformation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into insights and recommendations.

Non-patient facing.

High-volume, rapidly changing environment.

OTHER PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Adhere to all organizational information security policies and protect all sensitive information including but not limited to ePHI and PHI (Protected Health Information) in accordance with organizational policy, Federal, State, and local regulations.

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.description:
Support execution of digital programs across Gas Power Global Supply Chain, including ERP deployments, planning platforms, and manufacturing orchestration rollouts. This role owns program plan execution for an assigned workstream or site cluster within a larger program: tracking milestones, dependencies, site readiness, cutover, and stabilization. Global Process Digital Authorities own the process standards each program deploys, and Digital Technology owns technical design and configuration. This role keeps its assigned scope of the plan on pace and connected to the broader program. Success is measured by on-time deployment, stable operations after go-live, and sustained adoption at every site in scope.

**Job Description**
===================

**Program Planning and Execution**

* Maintain the program plan for an assigned workstream or site cluster: milestones, dependencies, risks, and resourcing gaps, feeding into the integrated program plan.

* Support the program cadence: kickoffs, pacing reviews, barrier-clearing sessions, and steering updates. Partner with Digital Technology program managers to establish clear roles and responsibility split (RACI) and handover points to allow business and technical plans move as one.

* Track scope, timeline, and stakeholder alignment within assigned scope. Escalate blockers early and bring a recommendation with every escalation.

* Report program status based on real deployment data, not optimism.

**Standards and Functional Readiness**

* Partner with Global Process Digital Authorities to confirm that assigned sites deploy the current global standard. GPDAs own the standard; this role ensures it lands intact.

* Support functional deliverables and drive business engagement through each gate: process standards, functional requirements, data readiness, user acceptance testing, and training execution.

* Partner with Master Data Governance on data conversion and readiness, and with the ERP configuration authority on template alignment.

**Site Readiness, Cutover, and Stabilization**

* Support site readiness assessments and go/no-go recommendations, working with each site's Local Process Digital Authority.

* Support the go-live sequence and hyper care for assigned sites: issue triage, defect prioritization, escalation paths, and stabilization metrics.

* Track adoption after go-live with the Change and Operations lead. Flag sites below threshold and drive corrective action with GPDAs and LPDAs.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply the DPE deployment playbook and surface improvement ideas so each wave deploys faster than the last.

* Capture lessons learned within 48 hours of a stopped or failed milestone, drive root cause analysis and feed them into the next wave.
  

  

**Required Qualifications for US candidates only:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economy, Supply Chain or Engineering
* 5+ years in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing in an industrial environment, with experience supporting multi-site program or deployment execution.

* Hands-on experience with ERP or planning system deployments in a manufacturing or supply chain context.

* Ability to support cross-functional programs spanning people, process, and technology.

* Solid program management fundamentals: scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, and escalation judgment.

* Ability to work effectively with business and technical teams without owning either
* Ability to travel up to 40%
  

  

**Required Qualifications for Hungary Candidates only:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economy, Supply Chain or Engineering
* Significant in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing in an industrial environment, with experience supporting multi-site program or deployment execution.

* Hands-on experience with ERP or planning system deployments in a manufacturing or supply chain context.

* Ability to support cross-functional programs spanning people, process, and technology.

* Solid program management fundamentals: scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, and escalation judgment.

* Ability to work effectively with business and technical teams without owning either
* Fluent in English language
* Ability to travel up to 40%
  

  
  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Exposure to integrated business planning, S&OP, or advanced planning platform deployments.

* Familiarity with change management; understands that go-live is not the finish line.

* Familiarity with lean manufacturing and standard work.

* Comfortable ramping quickly on new programs and thrives in a startup-style team inside a large enterprise.
* Note:
    
  **To comply with US immigration and other legal requirements, it is necessary to specify the minimum number of years' experience required for any role based within the USA.** **For roles outside of the USA, to ensure compliance with applicable legislation, the JDs should focus on the substantive level of experience required for the role and a minimum number of years should NOT be used.**

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner, Patient Access Product Innovation
jobs.description:
Valeris is a fully integrated life sciences commercialization partner that provides comprehensive solutions that span the entire healthcare value chain. Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. The company is headquartered in Morrisville, North Carolina and Jeffersonville, Indiana. To learn more about Valeris, please visit www.valeris.com.

You are the bridge between product direction and engineering: you turn platform needs into precise, buildable epics, stories, technical acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements, and you make sure engineering, architecture and Product Owners share one view of what is being built and why. Your customers are primarily internal: engineering, architecture, Product Owners, implementation and Operations teams.

This role sits on the Patient Access Product Innovation team and reports to the Product Manager, who sets product direction and priorities across the portfolio. You are a peer of the Product Owners: they own the business-facing product areas, and you own the technical foundations those areas are built on. You work in a tight pairing with engineering leads and architects, and you possess enough technical depth to review API contracts, challenge a design, and judge feasibility and risk without needing to write the code.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Technical Backlog & Prioritization

* Own and prioritize the technical backlog for assigned platform domains, balancing new capability, technical debt, reliability, security and operational improvements against roadmap commitments, using value and risk as the ranking criteria.
* Translate platform and engineering needs from the Product Manager, Product Owners and architects into well-defined epics, stories, technical specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build efficiently with minimal iteration.
* Lead backlog refinement with engineering leads and squads on a regular cadence: clarify and size work, surface dependencies and technical risk, and keep at least two sprints of groomed, estimated work ready.
* Run the sprint cadence for the technical teams (planning, reviews, retrospectives) and accept completed work against technical acceptance criteria.
* Hold a regular roadmap review (at least quarterly) with the Product Manager, engineering and architecture for your domains, and re-sequence as dependencies, risks and priorities change.
* Define the business outcome each technical initiative is meant to move (for example, faster new-program setup, higher reuse of shared capabilities, or better reliability), the KPIs that will measure it and the baseline, before it is prioritized, and report results after release.

Technical Requirements & Design Partnership

* Define functional and non-functional requirements for your domains, including performance, scalability, availability, security, privacy and auditability, with measurable targets.
* Review API contracts, data models and integration designs with engineering and architecture; evaluate connector and integration feasibility and identify technical risks early.
* Participate in design reviews and architecture discussions, represent product priorities in technical trade-off decisions, and record decisions and their rationale.
* Lead technical discovery and spikes with engineering leads and internal platform consumers to inform backlog priorities and reduce uncertainty before work is committed.
* Define data, interface and configuration requirements so that new capabilities are built once and reused across programs, solving the problem for many customers rather than one.

Shared Capabilities & Cross-Team Dependencies

* Own the shared-capability view for your domains: what exists, who consumes it, what is planned, and where a request from a Product Owner is better solved once, for everyone.
* Work with Product Owners to translate their needs into technical requirements, and bring shared needs and boundary questions to the Product Manager instead of solving them in isolation.
* Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams, integration and data platforms, vendors and other product areas; keep them visible and escalate conflicts that cannot be resolved at team level.
* Partner with Compliance, Legal, Security and Operations on privacy, security, audit and regulatory requirements that shape the technical roadmap.

Release, Quality & Reliability

* Plan and coordinate technical releases with engineering and QA, including release notes, rollout and rollback considerations, and communication to internal consumers.
* Define test strategy expectations and acceptance gates with QA and engineering, and own readiness from technical acceptance through production.
* Track and report on platform health and delivery measures (defects, incidents, technical debt, adoption of shared capabilities, and engineering delivery flow as a health indicator) alongside the opera

For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager

WHO WE ARE:

Network to Code is a network automation software company built by network engineers, for network engineers. Through our industry-leading Network Source of Truth and Automation platform, Nautobot, and expert services, we help some of the world’s largest and most complex enterprises build and operate smarter, more automated networks.

What sets us apart is our people—a collaborative team of innovators, engineers, and lifelong learners who enjoy solving complex challenges, sharing knowledge, and shaping what’s next. Our work is grounded in real customer needs, and the insights we gain in the field directly influence the technology we build.

Recognized as an Inc. Best Workplace, an Inc. 5000 company, and a leader in network automation and NetDevOps by Gartner, Network to Code is a place where talented people can do meaningful work and make a visible impact. Join us and help shape the future of network automation.

IMPACT OF THIS ROLE:

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the customer’s trusted partner after the sale, and a critical driver of NTC’s growth. You keep each customer engaged and coordinated through their consulting engagements and Nautobot software adoption, so they see real value from their investment. You lead the work to renew Nautobot subscriptions on time, and you connect customers and partners to the NTC resources that help them get the most from the platform.

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

* Own a portfolio of customers. Run onboarding, success plans, adoption milestones and quarterly business reviews.
* Coordinate across Delivery, Support, Product and Sales so the customer has one accountable point of contact during consulting engagements and software rollouts.
* Manage renewal readiness. Track every renewal from 120 days out, flag risk early using NTC’s customer health framework, and close on-time renewals together with the account owner.
* Drive adoption: apps, integrations, use cases and user growth. Connect customers and partners to NTC enablement such as training, certifications, the community and office hours.
* Identify expansion signals (new use cases, sites, apps, services) and hand qualified opportunities to the Client Executive or PS Sales Executive.
* Gather the voice of the customer for Product and Marketing, including references and case studies.
* Drive a high level and caliber of customer and partner facing activity and lead with curiosity and executive acumen.

WHAT YOU BRING:

* Drive Customer Outcomes: You measure success by the value customers get from Nautobot, not by activity, and you tie every success plan and QBR to their business goals.
* Own It: You own renewal readiness for your portfolio. When you see risk, you raise it early and come with a plan rather than waiting for the renewal date.
* Go the Extra Mile: You do what it takes to get a stalled rollout moving, whether that’s an extra working session, rallying the right NTC experts, or following through until adoption sticks.
* Stay Humble & Keep Learning: You keep growing your knowledge of network automation and the Nautobot platform. You learn from engineers, customers and the community, and bring those lessons back to the team.
* Be Empathetic: You understand the pressure network teams face when they’re asked to change how they work, and you meet customers where they are on their automation journey.
* Treat Others with Respect: You work with Delivery, Support, Product, Sales and partners as one team, so the customer gets one coordinated experience and colleagues get credit for their part.

WHAT YOU HAVE:

* 4–8 years in customer success, technical account management or engagement management for enterprise software and/or professional services.
* A record of hitting gross and net retention targets and on-time renewal rates.
* Working knowledge of network operations and automation. Nautobot, NetBox, Ansible, Python or source-of-truth experience is a plus.
* Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and keep executives and technical stakeholders aligned.
* Excellent written communication and QBR presentation skills.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED:

* On-time renewal rate and gross revenue retention (GRR)
* Net revenue retention (NRR) and expansion pipeline sourced
* Customer health score movement and adoption milestones achieved
* Customer and partner enablement participation (training, certifications)

LOCATION OF THIS ROLE:

* Remote, US
* Up to 25% travel

  

WHY US:

At Network to Code, you won’t just work with the brightest minds in network automation—you’ll grow alongside them. We’re a team of builders, innovators, and mentors who believe in pushing the boundaries of what’s possible while lifting each other up along the way.

Our culture is rooted in collaboration, inclusivity, and shared purpose. With a remote-first mindset and a globally distributed team, we stay closely connected through virtual events, team-building sessions, and day-to-day collaboration—so no matter where you are, you’ll feel part of something bigger.

We’re proud to foster an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual can thrive, whether you're a seasoned expert or a rising star.

We’ve been recognized as an Inc. Best Workplace and named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies—proof that we’re not only building cutting-edge solutions, but also a company where people love to work. Our impact has also been acknowledged in multiple Gartner reports, highlighting our leadership and innovation in the field.

When you join Network to Code, you’re not just joining a company, you’re joining a movement to redefine how networks are deployed, managed, and consumed. Come help us shape the future of networking, one automation at a time.

*Network to Code is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer dedicated to celebrating diversity and promoting a culture of inclusivity. We believe in equal opportunities for all employees and qualified applicants irrespective of race

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - MLS & Associations
jobs.description:
As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Lone Wolf, you will own the ongoing success of a portfolio of MLS and Association customers and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through our solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor, customer advocate, and internal orchestrator across the post-sale journey. Your role is to understand what success means for each customer, translate those goals into a clear plan, drive adoption and value realization, identify risk early, and coordinate the right resources to keep the customer moving forward. This is not simply a relationship-management or issue-escalation role. Our CSMs are expected to take accountability for the customer experience, lead with insight, maintain strong operational discipline, and ensure customers and internal teams have a clear understanding of goals, progress, risks, and next steps.

Our MLS and Association customers serve thousands of real estate professionals, and their success is measured both by their own organizational health and by the value they deliver to their members. You will work with executive leaders, staff, and board members to align our solutions to their strategic priorities.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, priorities, workflows, stakeholders, and desired outcomes, including their governance structure, member needs, and strategic goals. Translate those objectives into clear success criteria, milestones, and an actionable customer Success Plan.
* **Drive Adoption and Value:** Use product knowledge, customer conversations, usage data, and business context to identify adoption gaps and opportunities across the organization and its membership. Guide customers toward the workflows and behaviors that will help them realize greater value from Lone Wolf solutions.
* **Lead Proactive Engagement:** Conduct regular, proactive virtual and in-person meetings (1:1 or group) based on customer needs, segment, risk, and opportunity. Lead purposeful conversations with staff, executives, and, as needed, boards and committees to share updates and insights, provide best practices, address obstacles, and ensure customers are deriving ongoing value from their investment.
* **Manage Customer Health and Risk:** Continuously assess customer health indicators and usage data to proactively identify potential risks early, diagnose root causes, and lead documented recovery plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, and communication.
* **Orchestrate the Customer Experience:** Coordinate effectively across Support, implementation, Product, Sales, and other teams to deliver a connected customer experience. While you may not personally perform every action, you will maintain ownership of customer communication, internal alignment, and follow-through.
* **Build Renewal Readiness:** Ensure customers are positioned for renewal by helping them achieve measurable value, maintaining strong alignment with executive and board-level stakeholders, and surfacing risks well before the renewal date, accounting for governance processes, budget cycles, and formal review timelines. Partner closely with Sales or the appropriate commercial owner to provide an accurate, evidence-based view of account health, outcomes, and renewal risk.
* **Contribute to Team Excellence:** Share knowledge, contribute ideas, strengthen playbooks and best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

### **Requirements:**

* Customer-first mindset with a passion for driving customer outcomes and delivering value through every interaction
* 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing Success role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar) in a SaaS environment
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer business needs and connect software adoption to measurable outcomes
* Strong consultative skills, including discovery, active listening, problem diagnosis, and the ability to guide or challenge customers constructively
* Experience managing a portfolio of customers with competing priorities, risks, and deadlines
* Executive presence and comfort engaging senior leaders and presenting to boards, committees, or other group audiences
* A vocal team player and emerging leader: you speak up, contribute ideas, and help lift the team through positivity, initiative, and knowledge-sharing
* Strong written and verbal communication skills: you know how to simplify complex topics and tailor your message to your audience
* Solid problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to managing customer needs and resolving issues
* Collaborative and resourceful: you know when to own it and when to loop in teammates or other departments
* A keen interest in technology and helping customers adopt software to improve their business

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

The Account Manager serves as the commercial and strategic relationship leader across a dedicated portfolio of approximately 50 existing public sector accounts. Operating in close partnership with dedicated Solutions Architects and delivery consultants, this individual is directly accountable for maximizing net revenue retention (NRR) through proactive contract renewals and targeted account expansion. Growth opportunities span the complete suite of Conducive's offerings: third-party software licensing and ingest tier upgrades, specialized professional consulting services, and long-term managed services contracts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Account Governance & Portfolio Retention (~50 Accounts)**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own end-to-end commercial retention and health across ~50 public sector accounts, proactively tracking contract expiration dates, funding windows, and fiscal year-end deadlines.
* **Executive Business Reviews:** Lead structured quarterly business reviews (QBRs) to assess system utilization, platform health, SLA metrics, and future architecture roadmaps.
* **Proactive Health Monitoring:** Collaborate closely with delivery consultants and engineering teams to identify and remediate operational or adoption blockers well ahead of renewal cycles.

**2. Multi-Stream Growth & Quota Execution**

* **Software & Licensing Expansion:** Identify and close capacity ingest upgrades, additional workload licensing, and module additions across Splunk and associated observability/SIEM ecosystems.
* **Professional Consulting Services:** Scope and position technical consulting packages, cloud migrations, architecture modernizations, and bespoke implementation projects.
* **Managed Services Engagements:** Pitch and secure multi-year managed operations, continuous administration, monitoring support, and staff augmentation agreements.
* **Commercial Deal Leadership:** Shepherd opportunities from identification through technical scoping, proposal and statement-of-work (SOW) drafting, commercial negotiations, and contract closure.

**3. Technical & Pre-Sales Collaboration**

* **Solutions Architecture Alignment:** Partner with dedicated Solutions Architects and Sales Engineers to conduct technical discovery, architectural reviews, and solution demonstrations.
* **Value Translation:** Translate complex agency compliance mandates, logging bottlenecks, and security directives into clear, actionable technical workstreams.

**4. Public Sector Procurement & Operational Diligence**

* **Procurement Navigation:** Navigate government purchasing channels, state term contracts, piggyback mechanisms, GSA schedules, and sole-source justification requirements.
* **CRM Hygiene & Forecasting:** Maintain rigorous, audit-ready CRM documentation—tracking renewal pipelines, probability stages, contract values, and delivering highly dependable monthly and quarterly revenue forecasts.

**Role Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
* **Domain Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of professional experience directly within enterprise logging, SIEM, or observability domains (e.g., Splunk, Elastic, Datadog, Microsoft Sentinel).
* **Account Management Track Record:** Demonstrated success in a dedicated Account Management or Commercial Customer Success role with dual quota accountability for renewals and net-new expansions.
* **Public Sector Acumen:** Direct experience managing relationships and contracts within state, local, higher education (SLED), or federal government accounts, including understanding of fiscal budget cycles.
* **Technical Literacy:** Solid foundational understanding of SIEM/logging architectures, data onboarding, ingestion volume sizing, and compliance frameworks to independently lead initial qualification conversations.
* **Exceptional Detail Orientation:** High standard of organizational diligence, contract tracking rigor, and disciplined pipeline governance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Splunk Certifications:** Splunk Core Certified Power User, Advanced Power User, or equivalent platform credentials.
* **Blended Solution Selling:** Proven background structuring blended deals combining software licenses, advisory consulting SOWs, and recurring managed services.
* **Contract Vehicles:** Working knowledge of major public sector contract vehicles (e.g., NASPO ValuePoint, GSA Schedule 70/MAS, OMNIA, state-wide master contracts).

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Music School Program Coordinator provides administrative and operational support for CSMA’s Music School. The primary responsibility of this position is driving enrollment for both current and prospective students. Fulfillment of this responsibility requires coordinating faculty schedules, breaks, and availability using strong interpersonal communication and collaboration skills.

A secondary responsibility of this role is handling logistics for all Music School recitals. This includes managing event scheduling, ensuring necessary resources and equipment are provided, and attending recitals in person to facilitate the needs of faculty, student performers, and guests.

Reporting to the Music School Director, this position also works in alignment with the Music Classes & Faculty Supervisor to handle faculty needs and logistics. This is a key support role that requires high interpersonal resilience, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to provide professional support to faculty.

**Primary Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Enrollment Coordination:** Actively drive the enrollment process by managing new inquiries, conducting follow-up communication via phone and email, and navigating registration software. The priority in this operational area is to provide the level of follow-through necessary to maximize student enrollment and retention.
* **Faculty Schedules & Support:** Manage faculty teaching schedules, availability, and breaks with high precision. Optimize room schedules, resolve calendar conflicts, and serve as the primary point of contact for assigned faculty.
* **Recital Coordination:** Lead all logistical and administrative operations for student recitals (~40/semester), including communications, resources, and program creation. Responsible for in-person attendance and support at recitals, which requires working some weekends.
* **Student Lifecycle Support:** Coordinate the administrative logistics and success of trial lessons, teacher transfers, make-ups, and withdrawals, collaborating closely with faculty to ensure accurate record-keeping and process completion.
* **Customer Service:** Serve as a front-end representative, welcoming families and delivering exceptional customer service to ensure a positive and personable experience for students and parents.
* **Professional Composure:** Maintain a warm and helpful demeanor while supporting faculty, parents, and students. This role requires the ability to remain objective and professional when navigating interactions with assertive personalities, managing family concerns, or addressing faculty needs under pressure.
* **Student Services Collaboration:** Partner with the Student Services team as a key collaborator to ensure student data is accurate and that families experience a smooth transition from inquiry to active enrollment.
* **Departmental Assistance:** Provide occasional administrative support to cross-program areas and events, including the Music Classes program, as requested.

**Skills, Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in administration, arts management, or related field. A music degree is not required.
* **Working experience:**  2+ years of work experience with customer service, scheduling, or a relevant area. Strong background in music, music education, or instrumental/voice study to evaluate student needs and operate effectively within a music school.
* **Process & Detail Orientation:** Exceptional attention to detail and strong multitasking skills, with a proven ability to navigate complex, multi-step workflows. Proficient in managing information across multiple resources simultaneously, including registration systems, calendars, spreadsheets, and communication channels, to execute operations without error.
* **Event Coordination:** Strong real-time problem-solving skills to ensure seamless recital operations. Adept at assisting faculty and attendees during recitals while working collaboratively with concert hall and facility staff to manage logistics.
* **Independent Operation:** Ability to work independently and solve problems in real time when other administrative personnel are not available. Must remain calm and resourceful to effectively resolve unexpected logistical or client issues without immediate managerial oversight.
* **Professional Maturity & Composure:** Professional maturity, ability to remain calm, composed, and solutions-focused when navigating high-pressure situations, tight deadlines, or challenging interactions.
* **Google Workspace & Technology:** Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Sites, and Sheets), alongside a strong adaptability for quickly mastering new registration software, technology, and collaborative administrative tools..
* **Customer Relations & Sales:** Highly personable, building connections across phone, email, and in-person communications. Pairs a warm, accommodating approach with strong drive and enthusiasm to engage families, prioritize inquiries, and grow student enrollment.

**Schedule & Physical Requirements**

**Schedule**

* Tuesday - Friday (12:00 pm - 8:30 pm) & Saturday (9:00 am - 5:30 pm).
* Occasional weekend availability required to support recitals and special events.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms.

Pay: $28.00 - $30.00 per hour

* Health insurance

Experience:

* Simplify workflows, reduce manual work, and strengthen operational controls.
* Track operational measures such as budget accuracy, platform adoption, and process compliance.
* Use reporting and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements and confirm changes are working.

**What we look for:**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, Information Systems, or related field. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

* Experience administering business platforms, managing operational workflows, supporting budget and financial processes, and leading cross-functional work.

* Working knowledge of media processes, campaign workflows, reporting, and advertising and marketing technology.
* Experience creating processes, governance, documentation, training, and change-management support that teams can follow and use.
* Experience with budget tracking, reconciliation, reporting, and issue resolution.
* Strong program management, organization, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, follow up on commitments, and make sound decisions when the path is not fully defined.
* Ability to improve or build new processes while maintaining recurring operational work.
* Experience evaluating or using AI and automation to improve workflows, productivity, or quality.

**Workplace type:**

Hybrid: This individual will work 3 days onsite in Oakland, CA or Durham, NC. This role may also be eligible for remote.

**Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive.** **Learn more****.**

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 11 years of experience in management consulting, product management and strategy, policy, or research.
* Experience working with and analyzing data, and managing multiple cross-functional programs or projects.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Advanced degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with product and engineering teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

Product and Business Strategy Leaders bring together teams across Google’s functions to help products execute optimally. Our team pushes Google to scale at key points that refine our products and infrastructure by executing efficiently, bringing solid business sense and sound judgment, and working effectively across organizational lines.  
  
Our roles often include components of strategy (e.g. analyzing and understanding new trends in the industry, building business plans), operations (e.g. running the cadence of organizations, connecting the operating lines between our functions), and communications. Our team partners with senior leadership to run important functions that cross-cut our existing organizations and deliver high impact projects. We help Engineers, PMs, UX, and all of our other functions to build amazing products that delight our users, and then get those products into their hands.

The Strategic Response for Emerging Regulations team is responsible for developing strategies that uphold Google’s values around user trust in response to emerging regulations.

As a Manager on the Trust Strategy team, you will be at the forefront of shaping how Google's Knowledge and Information (K&I) products navigate complex AI policy, ecosystem, and regulatory challenges. Serving as a technical subject matter expert, you will co-design scalable product solutions that advance Google’s product objectives.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $176000 - $256000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive horizontal strategy at the intersection of product development and AI policy, translating external policy, ecosystem, and regulatory developments into actionable K&I product requirements, technical standards, and design principles.
* Bridge the gap between K&I product teams and Policy/Legal partners by translating complex product plans and technical architectures (across areas such as security, agentic products, content access, chatbots) to inform external engagement and advocacy.
* Partner directly with Product, Engineering, Policy, and Legal teams to resolve complex product-policy trade-offs and ensure product roadmaps and policy frameworks evolve in lockstep.
* Provide technical guidance to internal product teams, policymakers, and internet standards bodies on AI concepts, web protocols, and technical controls.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to K&I and cross-functional executive leadership, delivering analyses, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations to drive high-stakes product/policy decisions.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Our client is a rapidly growing consumer brand dedicated to making high-quality essentials accessible at radically affordable prices. As our client continues to expand, they are making a significant investments in their corporate infrastructure, including relocating to a substantially larger, more comprehensive headquarters facility in San Francisco.

Overview:

Shimmick, via our subsidiary Axia Electric, is seeking an experienced and results-driven **Electrical Project Manager** in Northern California/Bay Area/East Bay region to lead the successful execution of electrical construction projects from contract award through closeout. This role carries full responsibility for the overall performance of assigned projects, including safety, financial outcomes, schedule adherence, client satisfaction, and team leadership.

The Project Manager acts as the primary representative of Axia Electric to the client and is accountable for delivering projects that meet or exceed contractual obligations while aligning with company goals and standards.

At Axia Electric, we are problem solvers. Creative thinkers. Innovators. We approach each project with fresh ideas and big thinking in pursuit of better answers, better outcomes, and better experiences for our clients. We are resourceful, nimble and resilient. We work hard together—and with our clients—to deliver high-quality projects that are on time, on budget and beyond expectations.

**Axia Electric**

Since the early 1990s, Shimmick has been self-performing electrical scopes for infrastructure projects. In 2025 the Electrical Division rebranded to Axia Electric, a subsidiary to Shimmick Construction. Axia offers electrical, instrumentation, and process controls expertise for water and wastewater treatment; dams and locks; mass transit and rail; alternative energy; power generation and transmission; and commercial building projects. Our ability to self-perform this specialty offers additional value and enables us to better control cost and schedule for projects with major electrical and process mechanical scopes. Our clients include municipalities, water districts, sanitation districts, transit agencies, private developers, DOTs, and USACE

Axia Electric, headquartered in Riverside, California, focuses on large public owners in several states, across water resources, water treatment, transportation and transit markets. Over the past decade, the division has grown tremendously, securing major projects, including the $350 million North City Pure Water Facility in San Diego and the $235 million EVMWD Regional Water Reclamation Facility Expansion Project in Lake Elsinore, CA.

**Why Axia Electric**

At Axia Electric, Project Managers play a critical role in driving our reputation for excellence. This position offers the opportunity to lead impactful projects, build meaningful client relationships, and contribute directly to the company’s growth and success.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to the following:

**Project Leadership & Execution**

* Lead all aspects of project operations, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout
* Ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with contract requirements
* Oversee project setup, procurement, subcontracting, and resource allocation
* Identify and proactively manage risks, including cost exposure, schedule delays, and scope changes

**Safety & Compliance**

* Champion a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to all company and regulatory safety standards
* Ensure the safety and wellbeing of all employees, subcontractors, and partners on assigned projects

**Financial Management**

* Maintain full accountability for project financial performance, including forecasting, cost control, and profitability
* Safeguard company funds, assets, and resources
* Manage project budgets, change orders, billing, and cash flow
* Evaluate and mitigate financial risks associated with project execution

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships
* Ensure client satisfaction through consistent communication, responsiveness, and delivery excellence
* Represent Axia Electric professionally in all client interactions
* Support business development by identifying opportunities for repeat and future work

**Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Lead cross-functional project teams including field personnel, engineers, subcontractors, and vendors
* Provide clear direction, mentorship, and performance oversight to project team members
* Coordinate effectively with internal departments such as estimating, procurement, and operations

**Project Complexity & Risk Management**

* Successfully manage projects across varying levels of financial risk and operational complexity
* Assess and adapt management approach based on factors such as:
  + Contract value and project duration
  + Scope and technical complexity
  + Availability of proven methods or technologies
  + Environmental, safety, and working conditions

JDC is a non-profit organization which provides free legal services through its staff and volunteers to low-income Bay Area residents. Each year more than 1,600 volunteer attorneys, legal assistants, and law students work with JDC staff to serve nearly 7,500 indigent clients. JDC’s holistic advocacy approach seeks to address the social service and legal needs of clients.

The Federal Pro Bono Project Coordinator will work with JDC’s Federal Pro Bono Project, reporting to and working with the Supervising Attorney and Senior Staff Attorney. The Federal Pro Bono Project assists self-represented litigants in two ways: (1) staff attorneys at Legal Help Centers in the San Francisco and Oakland federal courthouses provide legal advice and guidance on federal civil cases; and (2) the Project matches litigants with volunteer attorneys to represent them in their cases.

This is a part-time position working 15 hours per week. Working hours are flexible but must be performed during regular business hours, Monday through Friday. The schedule should remain reasonably consistent from week to week. The position is fully remote, but office space is available at JDC’s downtown location should the successful candidate prefer to work some or all of their hours in a more social setting.

The Coordinator’s primary responsibilities are to conduct intakes and screening by phone and email, and to schedule appointments with the Project attorneys when appropriate. The Coordinator uses strong communication and organizational skills to keep the Project’s Legal Help Center legal advice work on track and ensure that litigants eligible for assistance are scheduled in a timely manner. Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in digital advertising, consultative sales, digital media sales, business development, online media environment, or digital marketing role, or 1 years of experience with an advanced degree.
* Experience working with advertisers, agencies, or clients.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in a business related field.
* 3 years of experience managing digital marketing and advertising campaigns and relationships with customers or agencies.
* Experience with Google Ads, Display and Video 360, Search Ads 360, YouTube, or similar digital advertising campaigns and platforms.
* Experience optimizing and troubleshooting products or services.
* Experience in customer-facing consulting or business.

**About the job**
-----------------

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals. Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $88000 - $124000 (USD) + 35% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Engage and influence key customer stakeholders by leading meetings to uncover marketing goals and Key Performance Indicators (KPI), translating them into actionable campaign strategies.
* Drive exceptional campaign results, quantify business impact, and demonstrate value to customers, maintaining account hygiene.
* Build and pitch data-driven solutions to maximize customer value through Google’s advertising solutions, manage objections, and ultimately achieve business growth goals.
* Analyze campaign data, ensuring performance is accurately tracked, and delivering measurable results aligned with customer objectives.
* Monitor performance data to extract key insights, identifying and cultivating qualified opportunities to drive future customer growth and build a pipeline.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

new_jobs.title: Operations Lead - Off the Charts Daly City
new_jobs.description:
Job Description: Operations Lead Position Summary

The Operations Lead is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the dispensary while ensuring compliance, exceptional customer service, and efficient store performance. This role serves as a key leader on the sales floor, managing opening and closing procedures, supporting team members, maintaining inventory accuracy, and ensuring all operational standards are met. The Operations Lead acts as a role model for the team and helps create a safe, compliant, and welcoming environment for both customers and employees. MUST BE 21+

Key Responsibilities - Store Operations

* Perform all opening and closing procedures, including securing the facility, cash reconciliation, and alarm activation/deactivation.
* Ensure the dispensary is clean, organized, fully stocked, and ready for business each day.
* Maintain operational excellence by following all company policies, SOPs, and state cannabis regulations.
* Monitor daily store performance and communicate operational updates to management.

Team Leadership

* Lead by example and provide guidance and support to budtenders and other team members throughout each shift.
* Delegate tasks and ensure daily responsibilities are completed efficiently.
* Assist with onboarding and training new employees on operational procedures and compliance standards.
* Foster a positive, professional, and customer-focused work environment.

Customer Experience

* Deliver exceptional customer service and assist with resolving customer concerns in a timely and professional manner.
* Support sales goals by ensuring team members provide knowledgeable product recommendations and maintain a positive shopping experience.
* Step in to assist during high-volume periods and ensure smooth customer flow.

Inventory & Compliance

* Assist with inventory counts, product receiving, restocking, and inventory reconciliation.
* Verify all cannabis products are properly labeled, stored, and tracked according to state regulations.
* Ensure all compliance requirements are followed, including age verification, ID checks, and accurate point-of-sale transactions.
* Report inventory discrepancies or compliance concerns to management immediately.

Cash Handling

* Perform register audits and cash drawer counts.
* Prepare deposits and complete end-of-day cash reconciliation.
* Maintain accountability for cash handling procedures and minimize discrepancies.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Previous leadership experience in retail, hospitality, or cannabis preferred.
* Knowledge of cannabis products and applicable state regulations is preferred.
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
* Must be able to work flexible schedules, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
* Must meet all state requirements for employment in a licensed cannabis dispensary.
* Will Need to Pass Criminal Background Check

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 pounds.
* Frequent bending, reaching, and stocking of merchandise.

Key Competencies

* Leadership and accountability
* Operational excellence
* Customer service
* Inventory management
* Cash handling accuracy
* Regulatory compliance
* Communication and teamwork
* Time management
* Problem-solving
* Attention to detail

Pay Range $20-$23 Depending on Experience + PLUS TIPS

Pay: $20.00 - $23.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance
