new_jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Territory Account Manager**
===================================================================================

At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We're hiring a **Territory Account Manager** at our rental facility in **Newark, CA**, and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. Territory Account Managers will be responsible for expanding our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Core Solutions branches offer construction equipment rentals including aerial equipment, earth moving equipment, material handling equipment and more.

**Pay:** $150,000 - $600,000 Total Compensation ($24,000 base salary + Uncapped commission with no market restrictions)

### **Primary Responsibilities**

* Territory management of a geographical area. Responsible for the full sales strategy execution from market analysis, sales forecasting, pipeline management and revenue growth, through contract negotiation and customer retention.
* Quickly respond to inbound leads and requests. Familiar with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems.
* New business development and Client acquisition/Account development. Expand our existing customer base by building relationships with contractors and construction company principals. Tell them about the numerous ways EquipmentShare can help save them money, make more money and operate more efficiently. In other words, educate them on how EquipmentShare solves their problems!
* Maintain and nurture existing customer relationships to ensure our customers are 100 percent satisfied with the level of service and support they receive from EquipmentShare. Keep them up-to-date about new or additional ways in which EquipmentShare can help improve their business with our comprehensive jobsite solutions.
* Promptly respond to and resolve customer inquiries, requests, complaints or other communications. Conducts sales presentations to prospective and existing customers.
* Develop new sales strategies and techniques to increase our market share and improve our customer experience.
* Manages and supports job site activities and projects with remote and on site involvement.
* Assists with Equipment rental, sales, and service when needed by customers on-site.

### **Why EquipmentShare?**

Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward.

We're a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive compensation: Base salary plus uncapped commission
* Commission guarantee period while building book of business

* Company provided truck or Vehicle allowance ($800/mo)
* Company provided cell phone or phone stipend
* Relocation assistance (discretionary)
* Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees
* 401(k) and company match
* Generous PTO + paid holidays
* Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)
* Company events and quarterly team activities
* 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home
* Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

### **About You**

You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We're looking for people who:

See challenges as opportunities  

Embrace change and continuous improvement  
* Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

### **Skills & Qualifications**

* First and foremost, we're looking for someone who's tenacious and innovative and possesses superior outside sales experience and skills with a proven sales track record
* Must be able to lift, carry, and place objects weighing up to 50 pounds without assistance.
* Heavy Construction Equipment or Industry knowledge (rental or construction) with experience in B2B is sales preferred, but not required (if you're a born salesperson, we'll train you on what you need to know and how to win more business)
* You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills
* You have the technical aptitude to adapt to the fast pace of a growing company and stay continuously educated on the latest EquipmentShare products and services
* You're competitive, self-motivated and results driven, but thrive in a team-oriented environment
* Ability to manage strategic and national accounts
* Must possess a valid driver's license with an immaculate driving record subject to a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) review.

### **Education and Experience:**

* High School diploma or equivalent
* Active applicable state class driver's license
* Experience in equipment rental company preferred

### **Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of driving or sitting.
* Must be able to lift up to 25 pounds at times.

### **A Workplace For All**

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world

new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Resellers are a major route for organizations to buy Claude. Our reseller program runs across two motions: hyperscaler resale, where partners resell Claude through the cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock today, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to follow), and direct resale, where partners resell on Anthropic paper through our own quote-to-order and billing systems. Each motion brings its own agreements, systems and cloud counterparts, and the program is expanding across regions at the same time.

As our Resale Operations Lead, you will run resale operations: how resellers get authorized, transact, get reported on, get paid and get supported, across both motions and every live cloud. The resale business team sets the strategy and the commercial framework. You will build and run the processes, playbooks and team that put that framework into practice, and keep them reliable as volume grows.

This is an operator and builder role, not a partner manager role. You will be hands-on in the detail of a private offer or a partner quote while you build the team, the vendor coverage and the Claude-powered automation that keep resale operations from growing in line with partner count.

*Reporting to Head of Partner Operations and Systems · San Francisco or New York based*

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Lead the resale operations team: set priorities, coach the reseller operations managers, and keep every region on the same playbooks rather than a set of local processes.
* Build the resale runbook and launch kit across AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft, so that authorizing, onboarding and supporting a reseller works the same way wherever it can, and each new cloud comes online from the kit.
* Run hyperscaler resale operations: marketplace authorizations and private-offer processing with the cloud alliance teams, and operational escalations with AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft, raised through the cloud alliance teams.
* Stand up direct resale operations: partner quotes in Salesforce CPQ, order forms, booking and provisioning, and commit tracking and true-ups, working with Deal Desk, Commercial Operations, Finance and Tax.
* Operate the program rules as controls that can actually run: deal registration to the published policy, eligibility checks, margin and rebate data, and the unauthorized resale process. Flag early what cannot be operated yet.
* Own the reseller transaction data, so that every reseller transaction traces to an end customer under the attribution rules Partner Strategy and Operations governs, partners are paid accurately and partner-sourced revenue can be measured.
* Scale through vendors and Claude: propose which resale work moves to outsourced teams or to Claude, run the vendor team's resale scope to a stated quality bar, and build automations with human checkpoints where a wrong decision carries risk.
* Run resale on a scorecard: application decision time, registration cycle time, attribution coverage, payout accuracy and launch readiness. Use it to tell the team and leadership what to fix next.

**What might make you a good fit**
----------------------------------

* Channel, reseller, distribution or partner operations experience at a technology company, including managing a small team.
* Hands-on depth in both motions: cloud marketplace resale (authorizations, private offers, deal registration) and direct or contract-based resale (quote-to-order, partner billing).
* A track record of building a resale or channel operations process from an early stage and running it as volume grew.
* Fluency in order-to-cash, including Salesforce CPQ or a comparable tool and the Finance, Deal Desk, Legal and Tax coordination that comes with it.
* Experience managing outsourced or vendor teams: scope, service levels, quality sampling and performance feedback.
* Sound judgment while the program is still moving. You can make the call with incomplete information, hold a control under pressure from sales or a partner, and keep the relationship intact.
* A builder's mindset and clear writing. You use tools like Claude to automate your own work, and you document what you build so a new teammate or vendor lead can run it.

**Strong candidates may also have**
-----------------------------------

* Experience on the partner or marketplace side of a hyperscaler, or in operations at a major distributor.
* Experience running partner rebate, margin or incentive operations, or launching a resale program in EMEA or APAC.
* Familiarity with the Claude API, Claude Code or MCP.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$215,000 - $300,000 USD

new_jobs.title: HR Generalist - People & Compliance
new_jobs.description:
HOKALI is a California-based EdTech company delivering after-school programs, extracurriculars, day camps, ELOP, recess, and aftercare to more than 240 partner schools and districts. Our frontline team of instructors and Site Directors is the heart of what we do, and we need a hands-on HR professional who keeps them compliant, supported, and engaged.

We are looking for a hands-on **HR Generalist** who owns the day-to-day people operations for our US workforce. This is not an advisory-only role: you will handle employee relations directly, sit down with staff in difficult conversations, and make sure every process complies with California labor law. You will also be the main driver of culture for a distributed, mostly part-time team.  
  
**Location:** Remote within California (**Los Angeles area or San Francisco Bay Area preferred**), with regular travel (~25–30%) across both regions. Because our largest school operations are concentrated in the Bay Area and Los Angeles, regular in-person presence across both hubs is a core part of this role:

* **If based in Los Angeles (preferred):** You will visit local LA school sites as needed and travel to the San Francisco Bay Area approximately **one week per month** (with company-provided accommodation at the HOKALI House).
* **If based in the SF Bay Area:** You will visit local Bay Area school sites **1–2 days per week**, with occasional travel to Los Angeles as needed.

### ***Responsabilities***

### **Compliance and California Labor Law**

* Ensure compliance with California and federal employment law, including wage and hour rules, meal and rest breaks, overtime, final pay timing, paid sick leave, and leave laws (CFRA, FMLA, PDL).
* Manage worker classification (exempt vs. non-exempt, employee vs. contractor under AB5) and flag risk proactively.
* Help reduce PAGA exposure through clean policies, accurate timekeeping, and documentation.
* Maintain required postings, notices, trainings (including harassment prevention), and personnel files.
* Support workers' compensation claims, EDD inquiries, and agency correspondence.

### **HR Administration and Payroll Support**

* Support and review payroll in partnership with Finance: make sure new hires, changes, and terminations are documented and reach payroll accurately and on time in TriNet.
* Run onboarding and offboarding end to end, including I-9s, background checks, and fingerprinting/clearances required for school sites.
* Administer benefits enrollment and answer employee questions on pay, benefits, and leave.
* Keep HR data clean and audit-ready in our systems (TriNet, Airtable).

### **Employee Relations**

* Act as the first point of contact for employee issues and complaints.
* Conduct investigations, document findings, and recommend outcomes.
* Prepare and deliver verbal and written warnings and performance improvement plans, in partnership with managers.
* Manage terminations from start to finish: documentation, legal review when needed, the conversation itself, and compliant final pay.
* Coach Site Directors and managers on handling performance and conduct issues correctly.

### **Culture and Engagement**

* Build and run culture initiatives for a distributed, largely part-time workforce: recognition, communication, and feedback loops.
* Visit school sites regularly to connect with staff and understand their reality.
* Track retention and engagement, identify drivers of turnover, and propose concrete fixes.
Support recruiting and seasonal hiring peaks as needed.  
* **Type:** Full-time, exempt
    
  **Salary range:** $75,000 – $95,000 per year, depending on experience

  
**Requirements**  

* 3-6 years of HR generalist experience in California, ideally with hourly or frontline workforces (education, childcare, hospitality, or retail is a plus).
* Solid, practical knowledge of California employment law: wage and hour, PAGA, AB5, leave laws, and termination requirements.
* Working knowledge of payroll processes; PEO experience (TriNet preferred) is a strong plus.
* Proven experience delivering warnings, running investigations, and handling terminations directly.
* Comfortable having difficult conversations with empathy and firmness.
* Highly organized, documentation-driven, and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup.
* Willing to travel to school sites across California.
* PHR, SHRM-CP, or CA-specific HR certification preferred.

  
**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance through TriNet
* 401(k) plan with company match
* Paid time off, paid holidays, and paid sick leave
* Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit and parking)
* Cell phone and internet stipend
* Annual professional development budget, including support for SHRM, PHR, or California HR certifications

new_jobs.title: Senior People Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
**About Hark**

Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory.

We're pairing that intelligence with next-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world.

To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next-generation AI hardware together - designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems.

**About the Role**

As we scale our operations, we're looking for a Senior People Operations Specialist to run the day to day HR engine for our workforce including onboarding, compliance, timekeeping, and employee support while helping build and improve the systems behind it. This is a hands-on, high volume role for someone who takes pride in getting the details right every time.

**Responsibilities**

**Onboarding & Off-boarding:**

* Build and run an end to end onboarding process for new hires: Offer to start handoffs, background check tracking, new hire paperwork, orientation logistics, badges/equipment coordination, and day one readiness
* Own I-9/E-Verify completion, re-verification, and record-keeping, maintaining audit-ready files at all times
* Execute off-boarding, including final pay coordination in line with California timing requirements, system deactivations, and exit documentation

**People Support & Administration:**

* Maintain accurate, confidential employee records and personnel files across all employees
* Process HRIS transactions (new hires, changes, terminations) with a high bar for data accuracy
* Prepare employment verifications, notices, and required documentation
* Serve as the first point of contact for all HR questions across the company including benefits, pay, PTO, policies, onboarding, and everything in between

**Immigration Support:**

* Coordinate day-to-day immigration operations in partnership with our outside immigration counsel including document collection, case tracking, and timely responses so filings stay on schedule
* Maintain organized, confidential immigration files and track key dates including visa expirations, extension windows, and work authorization reverifications
* Serve as a helpful, responsive point of contact for employees navigating visa processes, routing legal questions to counsel

**Requirements**

* 3-5+ years of experience in People Operations, HR administration, or HR coordination, ideally at fast-paced startup or AI/Robotics industry
* Hands-on experience with I-9/E-Verify administration and employee record-keeping
* Working knowledge of timekeeping systems and California wage-and-hour basics
* HRIS experience with strong data-entry accuracy; Justworks & Rippling experience is a plus
* Organized, detail-oriented, and dependable with high-volume work
* Clear, friendly communicator who can support employees at every level
* Strong working knowledge of California employment law, FLSA classifications, and benefits administration frameworks.

**Compensation**

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $110,000 - $200,000 annually.

The pay offered for this position may vary based on several individual factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional components/benefits depending on the specific role. This information will be shared if an employment offer is extended.

new_jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:

----------------------------------------------

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

**About the team + role**
-------------------------

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

  

We're looking for a talented and energetic Accounts Receivable Operation Analyst to join our accounting operations team. You will interact and coordinate with colleagues in Accounting, Finance, Treasury, Tax and various other departments across Robinhood to meet daily operational needs. This position will be responsible for increasing efficiency by accurately processing all receivable transactions and meeting associated deadlines. * Minimum 2–3 years of relevant AR experience in the tech industry or a comparable fast-paced, complex environment.
* Collaborative team player who builds strong cross-functional partnerships across the organization.
* Hands-on experience with Oracle ERP (or a comparable system).
* Highly organized, deadline-driven, and capable of processing and managing a high volume of transactions with strict accuracy.
* A professional who can work independently with minimal supervision and effectively manage their time to meet all deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail, ability to multitask, and a drive to learn and grow.
* Intermediate Excel skills (including v-lookups, pivot tables, and basic data analysis).
* Familiarity with or a strong eagerness to adopt AI-driven financial tools and automations to enhance AR operations.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
* Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you're ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

new_jobs.title: Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**

Affinity Psychological Services exists to provide clinicians something that is very difficult to find in the mental health landscape - the best of both worlds between private practice and employment. Clinicians get the autonomy and ownership of their work that private practice offers, along with the support, stability, and community of being part of a team - in a place they can stay through a lot of different seasons of life, personally and professionally.

Almost ten years later, we're 100+ clinicians across 10+ locations in the Twin Cities and St. Cloud, plus a telehealth team. Every one of our therapists is a fully licensed W2 employee - no trainees, no 1099s. We offer therapy, medication management, and psychological testing, and we take all insurance, including Medicaid, because we think good care shouldn't depend on what card is in your wallet.

We've grown entirely on our own, one office at a time, and we're still clinician-owned and clinician-run. In a field where most group practices our size have been bought by private equity, that matters a lot to us, and is a huge part of why we’re expanding our team.

**Who we’re looking for - role overview**

As Affinity grows, our operations have grown and processes once handled by the CEO now require systems and owners. We’re looking for an operations lead to help with the process of transforming tasks into teams and systems. We’re looking for someone to come in, roll up their sleeves, and ensure all the important things continue to get done here - both by building the team and by always being willing to do the work yourself as well.

* **Operations ownership:** You'd be one of three of us at the center of the practice: the CEO, another operations lead, and you. There's no pecking order here - our culture is one of who handles what, not who reports to whom.
* **Hands-on leadership role**: You'll make real decisions and solve operating problems directly, and then build the people and processes so those same problems don't keep coming back.
* **Variety of engagements:** On any given day, you might move from solving an issue at one of our locations, to a hiring decision, to a payroll exception, to choosing between two vendors, to a leadership conversation with me or our other operations lead. If that kind of day sounds energizing, you'll probably love it here.
* **Systems and processes creator:** The ideal candidate enjoys understanding a process, turning it into a system, and finding the right person whether it's themselves, an existing team member, or a new hire to own that process moving forward. Processes that are handed off to other team members would still be overseen by you, and team members would look to you for help on how to prevent or solve problems before looping in our CEO.
* **Impact driver:** This is mostly behind-the-scenes role. Our clinicians are the heart of Affinity, and a lot of what makes this place work for them is that they get to focus on their clients and their own practice within our practice. If you do this job well, most of them won't think about you much - they'll just notice that things run smoothly. The ideal fit enjoys enabling our clinicians to focus on making impact, we’ll handle the backend.

**Your first six months: building the team**

Your biggest job early on is to hire, onboard, and integrate five new roles so they're up and running within your first six months. Some of the details - full-time vs. part-time vs. fractional, pay, how each role reports out - are still open, and we'd love your thinking on them. Roughly in priority order:

* **Accounts Payable** (offshore, part-time). Someone to pay bills, keep our accounts straight across Affinity and our real estate entities, reconcile insurance payments against deposits, organize our business insurance coverage, and write SOPs so the work can be cross-trained.
* **Executive Assistant** (offshore, full-time). Supports CEO, keeps email and project follow-up timely and organized, routes tasks to the right people, and proactively manages things before others know they need to get done
* **Marketing & Business Development** (offshore, full-time). Takes over Google Ads, SEO, Google Business profiles, social, blog posts, website updates, client reactivation outreach, and building referral relationships with local employers, physicians, schools, and community partners.
* **Clinical Support Lead** (likely elevated from within our current site leads). Clinician mentorship, caseload development, retention, and client and clinician concerns.
* **Clinical Compliance Lead** (likely a psychologist hired from outside). HIPAA and cybersecurity, chart audits, documentation training, policies and SOPs, and the person we bring in on any report or legal issue.

Alongside the hiring, you'll set up how we communicate and stay in sync: a meeting rhythm for our operations team, for the broader team, plus a simple way for reports and communication.

**After that**

Once the team is in place, the work shifts to keeping it healthy and growing it as we grow:

* Oversee and support the roles you've hired, including coaching, feedback, and making the hard call when someone isn't working out
* Keep hiring team members as Affinity adds clinicians and locations
* Build and maintain SOPs and flow charts so knowledge doesn't live in one person's head
* Be a thinking partner to CEO and the other operations lead on how the practice runs
* Help figure out which roles come next - things like a de novo and acquisition manager, a recruiting lead, or more financial support

**Who you are**

* **You're a doer.** You'd rather build the thing than write a memo about it. When something breaks, you fix it, and then you fix whatever caused it to break.
* **You've hired and led people well.** You can tell the difference between someone who needs more training and someone who isn't the right fit, and you can handle both with kindness and clarity.
* **You're comfortable with remote and offs

new_jobs.title: Manager, Industry & Product Operations
new_jobs.description:
**Manager, Industry & Product Operations**

**Location:** Remote (U.S.) | Travel as needed

**Reports to:** VP, Product & Industry Operations

***Build the commercial lens behind every product line***

ECI serves more than 25,000 customers across five industries. Our business is complex by design — built through more than 60 acquisitions and spanning verticals from manufacturing to field service, retail, and beyond. That complexity creates a real gap: no one has consistently owned the cross-product view of how our software is actually living inside our customers.

Sales Ops watches the health of the sales engine. Marketing Ops watches the demand engine. CS Ops & Retention runs the retention engine.

Industry & Product Ops watches each product line and vertical as a business — covering the full arc from pipeline to churn, with the heaviest weight on one question: how is the product actually living inside our customers?

**This role runs and strengthens that function day-to-day.**

**What you'll do**

* **Own and maintain the product health scorecard.** Maintain a single scorecard by product line — pipeline, win rate, ASP, attach and cross-sell, GRR/NRR, and churn — with one definition set reviewed monthly by Product and GTM leadership.

* **Translate data into clear, actionable recommendations.** Convert product usage, CRM, billing, and support data into crisp summaries of where products are winning, leaking, or stalling — packaged for leadership to act on, not just review.

* **Prepare and coordinate the monthly product business review.** Own the prep work, scorecard assembly, and agenda — so the cross-functional conversation between Product and GTM leaders is focused, well-supported, and runs on time.

* **Analyze and escalate product-attributable churn.** Root-cause losses and churn at the product level, quantify the ARR impact, and surface the top findings with clear remediation options for leadership to prioritize into the product roadmap.

* **Maintain and influence the cross-sell whitespace and attach strategy.** Maintain and adjust the cross-sell whitespace model by vertical — in partnership with Sales Ops and CS Ops — to keep pipeline fed with real expansion opportunity.

* **Monitor the full product lifecycle and flag risk.** Track where each product wins, stalls, and loses customers from onboarding through renewal, and surface emerging patterns — with supporting data — for leadership to act on across the portfolio.

* **Implement and refine automated signal detection.** Do the hands-on build and maintenance work to automate health scorecarding, adoption tracking, and signal detection using agents — so the scorecard stays agent-maintained, not analyst-maintained.

* **Feed product intelligence into the broader GTM motion.** Ensure timely, accurate product- and vertical-level data reaches Sales Ops, CS Ops, and Product Management to support pipeline health, pricing decisions, and deal structure.

**Who you are**

* **5–8 years in product strategy and operations, business ops, or GTM strategy in multi-product B2B SaaS.** Experience in SMB, vertical software, or an acquisition-built portfolio is a strong plus.

* 5–8 years in product strategy and operations, business ops, or GTM strategy in multi-product B2B SaaS. Experience in SMB, vertical software, or an acquisition-built portfolio is a strong plus.

* Genuinely fluent in product and revenue analytics. You can go from raw data to a clear recommendation without waiting on a BI queue. Funnels, cohorts, retention curves, adoption metrics, and ARR math are familiar tools — you use them, not just request reports built on them.

* Effective presenting to and collaborating with Product and GTM leaders. You organize evidence clearly, translate data into crisp recommendations, and hold your own in cross-functional conversations without needing to own the room.

* AI-native by instinct. Your default is to automate the analysis, not run it manually every month. You know how to build and contribute to agent-maintained workflows, and you apply that standard to your own work first.

* A self-directed, consistent operator. You understand what good looks like, you execute reliably, and you help the people around you do the same. You thrive with clear direction and minimal hand-holding, and you raise problems early rather than waiting for someone else to notice them.

**Not required:** *An MBA, a consulting pedigree, or a "Product Ops" title. We care what you've built.*

**Why this role matters**

ECI's commercial decisions — roadmap investments, pricing, M&A integration, and retention strategy — have historically been made without a consistent, product-level read on commercial health. This role changes that.

You'll run the day-to-day operations of this function, keep the scorecard sharp and consistent, and serve as the intelligence layer connecting GTM and Product at the team level. The work you do will directly shape what ECI acts on, quarter over quarter.

**This is high-impact execution, not a support function.**

The Senior Program Manager leads strategic programs and drives hands‑on operational execution across multiple Bonneville Labs sites. The Senior Program Manager works at both the high‑level planning layer and the day‑to‑day execution layer to support operational excellence, member experience, and continuous improvement.

The Senior Program Manager supports our product mindset by treating each site, service, and workflow as a versioned product that requires continuous improvement, measurable outcomes, and predictable release cycles.

new_jobs.description:
Support execution of digital programs across Gas Power Global Supply Chain, including ERP deployments, planning platforms, and manufacturing orchestration rollouts. This role owns program plan execution for an assigned workstream or site cluster within a larger program: tracking milestones, dependencies, site readiness, cutover, and stabilization. Global Process Digital Authorities own the process standards each program deploys, and Digital Technology owns technical design and configuration. This role keeps its assigned scope of the plan on pace and connected to the broader program. Success is measured by on-time deployment, stable operations after go-live, and sustained adoption at every site in scope.

**Job Description**
===================

**Program Planning and Execution**

* Maintain the program plan for an assigned workstream or site cluster: milestones, dependencies, risks, and resourcing gaps, feeding into the integrated program plan.

* Support the program cadence: kickoffs, pacing reviews, barrier-clearing sessions, and steering updates. Partner with Digital Technology program managers to establish clear roles and responsibility split (RACI) and handover points to allow business and technical plans move as one.

* Track scope, timeline, and stakeholder alignment within assigned scope. Escalate blockers early and bring a recommendation with every escalation.

* Report program status based on real deployment data, not optimism.

**Standards and Functional Readiness**

* Partner with Global Process Digital Authorities to confirm that assigned sites deploy the current global standard. GPDAs own the standard; this role ensures it lands intact.

* Support functional deliverables and drive business engagement through each gate: process standards, functional requirements, data readiness, user acceptance testing, and training execution.

* Partner with Master Data Governance on data conversion and readiness, and with the ERP configuration authority on template alignment.

**Site Readiness, Cutover, and Stabilization**

* Support site readiness assessments and go/no-go recommendations, working with each site's Local Process Digital Authority.

* Support the go-live sequence and hyper care for assigned sites: issue triage, defect prioritization, escalation paths, and stabilization metrics.

* Track adoption after go-live with the Change and Operations lead. Flag sites below threshold and drive corrective action with GPDAs and LPDAs.

**Playbook and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply the DPE deployment playbook and surface improvement ideas so each wave deploys faster than the last.

* Capture lessons learned within 48 hours of a stopped or failed milestone, drive root cause analysis and feed them into the next wave.
  

  

**Required Qualifications for US candidates only:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economy, Supply Chain or Engineering
* 5+ years in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing in an industrial environment, with experience supporting multi-site program or deployment execution.

* Hands-on experience with ERP or planning system deployments in a manufacturing or supply chain context.

* Ability to support cross-functional programs spanning people, process, and technology.

* Solid program management fundamentals: scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, and escalation judgment.

* Ability to work effectively with business and technical teams without owning either

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Economy, Supply Chain or Engineering

* Ability to support cross-functional programs spanning people, process, and technology.

* Solid program management fundamentals: scope, milestones, risks, dependencies, and escalation judgment.

* Ability to work effectively with business and technical teams without owning either

* Ability to travel up to 40%
  

  
  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Exposure to integrated business planning, S&OP, or advanced planning platform deployments.

* Familiarity with change management; understands that go-live is not the finish line.

* Familiarity with lean manufacturing and standard work.

* Comfortable ramping quickly on new programs and thrives in a startup-style team inside a large enterprise.

new_jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE:

Network to Code is a network automation software company built by network engineers, for network engineers. Through our industry-leading Network Source of Truth and Automation platform, Nautobot, and expert services, we help some of the world’s largest and most complex enterprises build and operate smarter, more automated networks.

What sets us apart is our people—a collaborative team of innovators, engineers, and lifelong learners who enjoy solving complex challenges, sharing knowledge, and shaping what’s next. Our work is grounded in real customer needs, and the insights we gain in the field directly influence the technology we build.

Recognized as an Inc. Best Workplace, an Inc. 5000 company, and a leader in network automation and NetDevOps by Gartner, Network to Code is a place where talented people can do meaningful work and make a visible impact. Join us and help shape the future of network automation.

IMPACT OF THIS ROLE:

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the customer’s trusted partner after the sale, and a critical driver of NTC’s growth. You keep each customer engaged and coordinated through their consulting engagements and Nautobot software adoption, so they see real value from their investment. You lead the work to renew Nautobot subscriptions on time, and you connect customers and partners to the NTC resources that help them get the most from the platform.

* Own a portfolio of customers. Run onboarding, success plans, adoption milestones and quarterly business reviews.

WHAT YOU BRING:

* Stay Humble & Keep Learning: You keep growing your knowledge of network automation and the Nautobot platform. You learn from engineers, customers and the community, and bring those lessons back to the team.

* Treat Others with Respect: You work with Delivery, Support, Product, Sales and partners as one team, so the customer gets one coordinated experience and colleagues get credit for their part.

WHAT YOU HAVE:

* 4–8 years in customer success, technical account management or engagement management for enterprise software and/or professional services.
* A record of hitting gross and net retention targets and on-time renewal rates.
* Working knowledge of network operations and automation. Nautobot, NetBox, Ansible, Python or source-of-truth experience is a plus.
* Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and keep executives and technical stakeholders aligned.
* Excellent written communication and QBR presentation skills.

HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED:

* On-time renewal rate and gross revenue retention (GRR)
* Net revenue retention (NRR) and expansion pipeline sourced
* Customer health score movement and adoption milestones achieved
* Customer and partner enablement participation (training, certifications)

LOCATION OF THIS ROLE:

* Remote, US
* Up to 25% travel

  

WHY US:

At Network to Code, you won’t just work with the brightest minds in network automation—you’ll grow alongside them. We’re a team of builders, innovators, and mentors who believe in pushing the boundaries of what’s possible while lifting each other up along the way.

Our culture is rooted in collaboration, inclusivity, and shared purpose. With a remote-first mindset and a globally distributed team, we stay closely connected through virtual events, team-building sessions, and day-to-day collaboration—so no matter where you are, you’ll feel part of something bigger.

We’re proud to foster an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual can thrive, whether you're a seasoned expert or a rising star.

We’ve been recognized as an Inc. Best Workplace and named to the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private companies—proof that we’re not only building cutting-edge solutions, but also a company where people love to work. Our impact has also been acknowledged in multiple Gartner reports, highlighting our leadership and innovation in the field.

When you join Network to Code, you’re not just joining a company, you’re joining a movement to redefine how networks are deployed, managed, and consumed. Come help us shape the future of networking, one automation at a time.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager - MLS & Associations
new_jobs.description:
As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Lone Wolf, you will own the ongoing success of a portfolio of MLS and Association customers and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through our solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor, customer advocate, and internal orchestrator across the post-sale journey. Your role is to understand what success means for each customer, translate those goals into a clear plan, drive adoption and value realization, identify risk early, and coordinate the right resources to keep the customer moving forward. This is not simply a relationship-management or issue-escalation role. Our CSMs are expected to take accountability for the customer experience, lead with insight, maintain strong operational discipline, and ensure customers and internal teams have a clear understanding of goals, progress, risks, and next steps.

Our MLS and Association customers serve thousands of real estate professionals, and their success is measured both by their own organizational health and by the value they deliver to their members. You will work with executive leaders, staff, and board members to align our solutions to their strategic priorities.

### **Responsibilities:**

* **Own Customer Outcomes:** Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, priorities, workflows, stakeholders, and desired outcomes, including their governance structure, member needs, and strategic goals. Translate those objectives into clear success criteria, milestones, and an actionable customer Success Plan.
* **Drive Adoption and Value:** Use product knowledge, customer conversations, usage data, and business context to identify adoption gaps and opportunities across the organization and its membership. Guide customers toward the workflows and behaviors that will help them realize greater value from Lone Wolf solutions.
* **Lead Proactive Engagement:** Conduct regular, proactive virtual and in-person meetings (1:1 or group) based on customer needs, segment, risk, and opportunity. Lead purposeful conversations with staff, executives, and, as needed, boards and committees to share updates and insights, provide best practices, address obstacles, and ensure customers are deriving ongoing value from their investment.
* **Manage Customer Health and Risk:** Continuously assess customer health indicators and usage data to proactively identify potential risks early, diagnose root causes, and lead documented recovery plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, and communication.
* **Orchestrate the Customer Experience:** Coordinate effectively across Support, implementation, Product, Sales, and other teams to deliver a connected customer experience. While you may not personally perform every action, you will maintain ownership of customer communication, internal alignment, and follow-through.
* **Build Renewal Readiness:** Ensure customers are positioned for renewal by helping them achieve measurable value, maintaining strong alignment with executive and board-level stakeholders, and surfacing risks well before the renewal date, accounting for governance processes, budget cycles, and formal review timelines. Partner closely with Sales or the appropriate commercial owner to provide an accurate, evidence-based view of account health, outcomes, and renewal risk.
* **Contribute to Team Excellence:** Share knowledge, contribute ideas, strengthen playbooks and best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

### **Requirements:**

* Customer-first mindset with a passion for driving customer outcomes and delivering value through every interaction
* 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing Success role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar) in a SaaS environment
* Demonstrated ability to understand customer business needs and connect software adoption to measurable outcomes
* Strong consultative skills, including discovery, active listening, problem diagnosis, and the ability to guide or challenge customers constructively
* Experience managing a portfolio of customers with competing priorities, risks, and deadlines
* Executive presence and comfort engaging senior leaders and presenting to boards, committees, or other group audiences
* A vocal team player and emerging leader: you speak up, contribute ideas, and help lift the team through positivity, initiative, and knowledge-sharing
* Strong written and verbal communication skills: you know how to simplify complex topics and tailor your message to your audience
* Solid problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to managing customer needs and resolving issues
* Collaborative and resourceful: you know when to own it and when to loop in teammates or other departments
* A keen interest in technology and helping customers adopt software to improve their business
* **Preferred:** Experience with MLS, REALTOR® associations, or other membership-based or governance-driven organizations, or a strong working knowledge of the real estate industry
* Willingness to travel up to 20% for customer meetings and industry events

new_jobs.description:
United States (Remote) Category Customer Success, Services, & Support

  

Job description

At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  
  
When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the mic and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.

### **Senior Consultant, Member Experience**

### **The Role**

Health plans and healthcare providers are navigating an increasingly complex landscape marked by evolving quality frameworks, shifting regulatory standards, and rising expectations from the populations they serve. As a Senior Consultant in Member Experience, you will serve as a trusted advisor bringing health plans and healthcare providers together.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of a major industry shift: bridging the traditional divide between payers and providers to improve the end-to-end patient and member journey. Working directly with health plan leaders, medical groups, and clinical operations teams, you will combine deep operational healthcare knowledge with proven continuous improvement methodologies to build strong cross-entity partnerships, elevate quality metrics, and drive measurable performance across Star Ratings and CAHPS. If you are passionate about being a change agent whose work directly impacts the care and lives of millions of people nationwide, this role is for you.

### **How You’ll Find Success**

* **Payer-Provider Bridge Builder:** Understands the operational realities of both health plans and medical provider groups; builds genuine collaboration and trust across executive leaders, physician groups, and clinical staff.
* **Continuous Improvement Driver:** Skilled in applying structured problem-solving and quality improvement frameworks (e.g., Plan-Do-Study-Act / PDSA cycles) to uncover root causes and build sustainable operational workflows.
* **Coach & Facilitator:** Comfortably engages and trains diverse audiences—from executive roundtables and town halls to clinic managers and frontline teams—through interactive virtual sessions and hands-on onsite workshops.
* **Data-to-Action Interpreter:** Adept at reading and interpreting complex performance metrics (CAHPS, HEDIS, HOS, Star Ratings) and translating them into clear, practical roadmaps without getting lost in technical reporting.
* **Adaptable & Client-Centric:** Thrives in a dynamic consulting environment, easily shifting between strategic advisory, remote delivery, and onsite client facilitation across diverse regions.

### **How You’ll Grow**

* **Expand Scope of Influence:** Broaden your reach beyond a single health system or payer to guide dozens of medical groups and major regional/national health plans across the country.
* **Lead Cutting-Edge Transformation:** Be an active driver in one of healthcare’s most critical evolutions—uniting health plans and provider networks into collaborative care partners.
* **Hone Executive Advisory & Facilitation:** Deepen your expertise in leading high-stakes client engagements, executive coaching, office hours, and collaborative exchange programs.
* **Deepen Quality & Regulatory Expertise:** Strengthen your mastery of modern healthcare quality programs, value-based care models, Medicare Advantage Star Ratings, Medicaid, and Commercial lines of business.
